"A switch reduces unnecessary traffic by sending data only to the destination. An Ethernet card has a unique physical address called the MAC address. A router can connect networks that use the same protocol."
(i) Which device is called an intelligent hub? (1)
(ii) Explain the term 'repeater' as it relates to this theme. (1)
(iii) Explain the reason behind the following: Repeaters are used in long cable runs. (2)
items.answer: (i) Switch (ii) A device that regenerates and amplifies weak signals so that they can travel longer distances. (iii) Signals weaken (attenuate) as they travel along a cable.
items.markingKey: 1+1+2 marks: (i) Switch (ii) A device that regenerates and amplifies weak signals so that they can travel longer distances. (iii) Signals weaken (attenuate) as they travel along a cable.

Read the following extract on data communication and answer the questions that follow.
"A channel with higher bandwidth can carry more data per second. The five components of data communication are sender, receiver, message, communication medium and protocol. Data transfer rate is expressed in units such as Kbps, Mbps and Gbps."
(i) Data transfer rate is measured in: (1)
(ii) Explain the term 'bandwidth' as it relates to this theme. (1)
(iii) Explain the reason behind the following: Communication between two devices needs a common protocol. (2)
items.answer: (i) bits per second (bps) (ii) The range of frequencies a channel can carry, measured in hertz (Hz). (iii) Both must follow the same rules to interpret the data correctly.
items.markingKey: 1+1+2 marks: (i) bits per second (bps) (ii) The range of frequencies a channel can carry, measured in hertz (Hz). (iii) Both must follow the same rules to interpret the data correctly.
